summary: Example group_vars/slxos.yml with network_cli, community.network.slxos, user, vaulted password and optional proxy command.
questions: What group_vars do I need for SLX-OS?

answer_card.title: SLX-OS group_vars example
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
ansible_connection: ansible.netcommon.network_cli
ansible_network_os: community.network.slxos
ansible_user: myuser
ansible_password: !vault...
ansible_paramiko_proxy_command: '-o ProxyCommand="ssh -W %h:%p -q bastion01"'
```
Drop the password with SSH keys and the proxy line for direct access.
